banner_subtitle: Takes about 2 minutes — we'll build your personalised plan.
welcome_title: Let's check where your shop stands
welcome_text: We'll ask a few quick questions so Movestock can guide you through everything you need to stay open and compliant.
nationality_title: Are you a South African citizen?
nationality_subtitle: This helps us show you the right requirements and any funding you might qualify for.
naturalised_subtitle: The Spaza Shop Support Fund accepts foreign-born owners who became SA citizens before 1994.
visa_title: Tell us about your visa or permit
visa_subtitle: Your trading permit is linked to your visa. Knowing the type and expiry helps us remind you to renew on time.
fronting_body: All business registrations must be in your own name using your own valid documents. Registering a business on behalf of someone who lacks the right to trade is a criminal offence under both the B-BBEE Act (Section 13O — up to 10 years in prison and a fine of 10% of annual turnover) and the Immigration Act (Section 42). Movestock helps YOU register YOUR business properly.
visa_type_label: What type of visa or permit do you have?
visa_expiry_label: When does your visa or permit expire?
visa_expiry_dont_know: I don't know / it doesn't expire
municipality_title: Which municipality is your shop in?
municipality_other_btn: Not sure? Tell us your area
municipality_no_match: We'll show you general info. You can update this later in Settings.
employees_subtitle: If you employ staff, you also need UIF registration. We'll ask about it next.
documents_title: Which of these do you already have?
documents_subtitle: Tap once if you have it. Tap again if you're not sure. Tap once more to clear.
food_safety_title: Have you or your staff completed food safety training?
food_safety_subtitle: Health inspectors check for this when issuing your Health Certificate.
fund_intro: The government offers up to R300,000 to spaza shops — grants for stock, fridges, shelving, and training. Some is free money, some is interest-free loans.
fund_question: Would you like Movestock to check if you qualify?
